jupas.shortDescription: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) and The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Shenzhen) (CUHK (SZ)). The programme aims to unravel the mysteries of outer space and our own planet. This highly interdisciplinary undergraduate major combines the realms of aerospace science and Earth informatics, equipping students to harness the power of data and invent innovative solutions to explore the outer space and to safeguard our planet Earth. Students will pursue a major in Aerospace Science and Earth Informatics at CUHK along with another major from among specific academic disciplines (Engineering, Science and Social Science) offered by either CUHK or CUHK(SZ). They will attend classes and participate in learning and research activities at both campuses. Major programmes offered by CUHK: Earth and Environmental Sciences Energy and Environmental Engineering Geography and Resource Management (in collaboration with the Institute of Space and Earth Information Science) Mechanical and Automation Engineering Physics Major programmes offered by CUHK(SZ): Data Science and Big Data Technology Electrical and Computer Engineering New Energy Science and Engineering Physics Urban Management Students will be prepared to step into a world of ample career opportunities, with skills and knowledge sought after by aerospace companies, space agencies, environmental consulting firms, geographic information system (GIS) companies, government agencies, research institutes, and NGOs. Students will also be ready for advanced studies in the Earth and planetary sciences, space physics, climate science, aerospace engineering, information technology, and data science.

admission.title: Admission Requirements
content: Programme: Aerospace Science and Earth Informatics & X Double Major (Informatics & X Double Major)
Tuition fee: HK$47,000 per annum (local students)
Interview: Yes (selected applicants may be invited)
- Any 2 elective subjects: Level 3 (may include M1/M2 as one elective)

curriculum.title: Curriculum
content: This is a collaborative double major programme between CUHK and CUHK (Shenzhen).
Students pursue a major in Aerospace Science and Earth Informatics at CUHK, plus a second major from a list of disciplines offered by either CUHK or CUHK(SZ).
Classes and research activities take place on both the Hong Kong and Shenzhen campuses.
- Geography and Resource Management (in collaboration with the Institute of Space and Earth Information Science)
- Data Science and Big Data Technology
The curriculum combines aerospace science, Earth informatics, and data-driven problem-solving, preparing students to explore outer space and protect our planet.

career.title: Career Prospects
content: Graduates are equipped with interdisciplinary skills sought after by:
- NGOs focused on climate and sustainability
The programme also prepares students for advanced studies in:

campus.title: Campus Life
content: CUHK's main campus is located in Shatin, offering a spacious and green environment with a unique college system.
Students in this programme will experience both the CUHK Shatin campus and the CUHK (Shenzhen) campus, gaining cross-border exposure.
College life provides opportunities for holistic development, including residential education, cultural activities, and student societies.
The programme leverages the Institute of Space and Earth Information Science, which has contributed to lunar exploration and satellite data analysis.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness
content: The programme is highly selective, with a strong emphasis on Physics and Geography (weighted x2).
Applicants with strong performance in M1/M2, Physics, and Geography are at an advantage.

alumni.title: Alumni and Faculty Excellence
content: The programme is newly launched (first intake 2022/23), so no graduates have yet become notable alumni.
Faculty includes experts from CUHK's Institute of Space and Earth Information Science, which has contributed to lunar exploration and satellite data analysis.
The programme is jointly offered by the Faculty of Engineering and the Faculty of Science, leveraging strong interdisciplinary research.

scholarships.title: Scholarships and Financial Aid
content: CUHK offers a range of entrance scholarships for local and non-local students based on academic merit.
Local JUPAS students may be eligible for admission scholarships that cover tuition fees and living expenses.
The university also participates in the HKSAR Government's Targeted Scholarship and Financial Support Scheme (TSFS) and the Non-local Student Scholarship Scheme (NLSPS).

tips.title: Ace Sir's JS4750 Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: - Aim for a Best 5 score of at least 44.25 (median) to be competitive.
- With LQ at 38.25, a score above 40 is essential for a realistic chance.
- Physics and Geography are weighted x2 — strong grades here significantly boost your score.
- If you take both, even a 5* can make a big difference.
- M1/M2 is a preferred subject and appears in the median profile at Level 5.
- A high grade in M1/M2 demonstrates quantitative readiness for the programme.
- The programme requires an interview — practice articulating your interest in aerospace and Earth informatics.
- Be ready to discuss how you would contribute to interdisciplinary research.
- The median admit had three electives at 5*, 5, and 4 — aim for at least two strong electives.
- Choose electives that align with the programme's focus (e.g., Physics, Geography, ICT).
- Research the available second majors at CUHK and CUHK(SZ) to show genuine interest.
- Mention specific combinations (e.g., ASEI + Data Science) in your interview.
- Highlight your willingness to study in both Hong Kong and Shenzhen.
- This demonstrates adaptability and a global mindset.
- With only 60 Band A applicants and 17 offers, Band A placement is critical.
- Ensure JS4750 is your top choice if you meet the score thresholds.
- As a new programme, check the official website (https://www.sci.cuhk.edu.hk/aseidm) for updates.
- Follow CUHK admissions social media for any changes in requirements or intake.

admission.title: 入學要求
content: 課程名稱：航天科學與地球信息學及Ｘ雙主修課程
2025 年 JUPAS 入學分數（最佳 5 科）：
中位數錄取者科目成績（M 行）：
- 數學延伸部分單元一或二：5
下四分位數錄取者科目成績（LQ 行）：
- 數學延伸部分單元一或二：4
- 數學（必修部分）：第 2 級
- 任何 2 個選修科目：第 3 級（可包括 M1/M2 作為一個選修科）
- Band A 每錄取申請人數：約 3.5

curriculum.title: 課程結構
content: 此為香港中文大學與香港中文大學（深圳）合辦的雙主修課程。
學生在中大修讀航天科學與地球信息學主修，並從中大或港中大（深圳）提供的指定學科中選擇第二主修。
課堂及研究活動在港深兩地校園進行。
- 地理與資源管理學（與太空與地球信息科學研究所合辦）
港中大（深圳）提供的主修課程：
- 數據科學與大數據技術
課程結合航天科學、地球信息學及數據驅動解難，培養學生探索太空及保護地球的能力。

career.title: 就業前景
content: 畢業生具備跨學科技能，受以下機構青睞：
- 關注氣候與可持續發展的非政府組織
課程亦為以下領域的深造做好準備：

campus.title: 校園生活
content: 中大主校園位於沙田，環境寬敞綠化，並設有獨特的書院制度。
本課程學生將同時體驗中大沙田校園及港中大（深圳）校園，獲得跨境學習機會。
書院生活提供全人發展機會，包括住宿教育、文化活動及學生社團。
課程依托太空與地球信息科學研究所，該所曾參與月球探測及衛星數據分析。

competitiveness.title: 競爭情況
content: - Band A 每錄取申請人數：約 3.5
課程競爭激烈，尤其重視物理及地理（比重 x 2）。
在 M1/M2、物理及地理表現優異的申請者具優勢。

alumni.title: 校友及學系成就
content: 本課程為新開辦課程（首屆 2022/23 學年），暫未有畢業生成為知名校友。
教學團隊包括中大太空與地球信息科學研究所的專家，該所曾參與月球探測及衛星數據分析。
課程由工程學院及理學院合辦，具備強大的跨學科研究實力。

scholarships.title: 獎學金及資助
content: 中大提供多項入學獎學金，根據學業成績頒發予本地及非本地學生。
本地 JUPAS 學生可申請涵蓋學費及生活費的入學獎學金。
大學亦參與政府「特定獎學金及財政支援計劃」（TSFS）及「非本地學生獎學金計劃」（NLSPS）。

tips.title: Ace Sir 的 JS4750 策略 — 9 個可行貼士
content: - 最佳 5 科成績應達 44.25（中位數）以具競爭力。
- 下四分位數為 38.25，分數高於 40 才有較大機會。
- 物理及地理比重 x 2，優異成績可大幅提升總分。
- 若同時修讀兩科，5* 級別尤為有利。
- M1/M2 為優先科目，中位數錄取者達第 5 級。
- 高分 M1/M2 展示數理能力，符合課程要求。
- 課程需要面試，練習表達你對航天及地球信息學的興趣。
- 準備討論你如何為跨學科研究作出貢獻。
- 中位數錄取者有三個選修科（5*, 5, 4），目標至少兩個強選修。
- 選擇與課程相關的選修科（如物理、地理、資訊及通訊科技）。
- 研究中大及港中大（深圳）提供的第二主修選項，展現真誠興趣。
- 面試時提及具體組合（如航天科學與地球信息學 + 數據科學）。
- 強調你願意在港深兩地學習，展示適應力及國際視野。
- 僅 60 人申請 Band A，17 人獲錄取，Band A 位置至關重要。
- 若分數達標，確保 JS4750 為首選。
- 作為新課程，定期瀏覽官方網站（https://www.sci.cuhk.edu.hk/aseidm）獲取更新。
- 關注中大招生社交媒體，了解要求或學額變動。
